# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Pagination

PagedCollection, DelegatePagedCollection, SearchQuery debounce. Uses AddRange (one notify).

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Pagination
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.5.0-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0 only.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Pagination --prerelease

## Use this package when

- A MVVMExpress list needs page fetch, refresh, or search debounce

## Do not use when

- They only need ObservableRangeCollection — that is already in Core
- They need a remote infinite-scroll control — this is the ViewModel collection, not a UI control

## Alternatives

App-level paging, ReactiveUI, CommunityToolkit collections.
